requirements.text: One person's action raises one host intent at most and causes one render of what it changes; the states it passes through (loading, then the answer) are the only further renders. Measurement after a render writes styles directly, never by asking for another render.
requirements.guidance: Probes count renders per action: a table sort, a search (data-view-reloads), opening a record (property-view-loading).

requirements.text: A component batches its own updates into one frame; property changes made in one task are one render.
An answer to a request that is no longer the latest is dropped (sequence or epoch), never rendered; the newest request wins.
Every request a component makes has the same five states: loading, populated, empty, no-access, error -- the same words in every component and every port.
Loading is drawn as the component's skeleton of its final shape, never as text and never as an empty answer; a component is born loading, so its first frame is the skeleton.
requirements.guidance: Framework: data-sf-skeleton shapes in core, presentation.skeleton in the manifest; probes table-first-paint and property-view-loading.

requirements.text: Empty, no-access and error are drawn by sf-empty-state, inline in lists and menus, as a block in pages, with the error offering a retry.
A host that is not ready keeps the request pending; it never answers unavailable for «not yet». Unavailable means «could not», and the person is shown an error.

A composite gives its parts data through properties and attributes and hears them through events; a part never reaches up into its composite or across into a sibling. Only the outermost composite talks to the host, through its declared port.
Components side by side talk only through declared composition ports and routes (simai.interface-fragment); they never find each other in the DOM.
State that belongs to the person and spans components -- view preferences -- goes through SF.Preferences; nothing else is shared through globals.

What repeats many times -- cells, list rows, tags in a cell -- is drawn as markup with the Framework's component classes, not as one Smart element per value; Smart elements are for what is interactive or stateful.
requirements.guidance: Probe table-cell-weight: a page of rows holds a budget of Smart elements.

requirements.text: Styles and scripts a page will need are asked for together and once; a component's code does not discover its parts one by one as it renders, and an asset already on the page is never asked for again.
Nothing moves under the pointer: a panel keeps its width whatever its content says, a list keeps its rows' height while it loads, and a skeleton's box is the loaded box within one ladder step.
A component never shows a state it is not in -- no «empty» before the first answer, no «unavailable» before a record is named, no unstyled content before its sheet.
requirements.guidance: Probes watch the first frames with the sheet withheld (table-first-paint).

requirements.text: Animation and pulsing stop for prefers-reduced-motion; a skeleton holds still, a transition is skipped.
A component that throws while drawing reports sf-component-error and its boundary shows the error state with a retry; nothing else on the page goes with it.
Work a component or the Loader schedules runs even where no animation frame comes (an iframe out of view, a hidden tab), by a short timer fallback.

Each rule has a check in the build -- renders per action, the five states, no DOM reach across components, skeleton geometry, elements per cell, reduced motion -- and a component that does not meet them does not pass the gate.

simai.ownership.builds_on: the rules of the road (ui-control control/designs/2026-10-15-interaction-rules.md), measured on the admin polygon
simai.ownership.scope_note: How every Smart component -- primitive or composite -- loads, talks and draws, vertically (a composite and its parts) and horizontally (components side by side), so a new component fits in without conventions of its own. A product's admin pages build on it through their own page standard.
simai.ownership.origin: Owner requests of 2026-10-15 (remarks 5-8: loading looked assembled on the fly, the admin stuttered, «элемент не доступен» flashed) and 2026-10-16 (publish the rules as a standard).
